 Mahrez in focus as Inzaghi sounds caution before Al-Hilal face Al-Shamal in AFC Champions League Elite 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Simone Inzaghi set a firm tone before Al-Hilal 's trip to Al-Shamal in the AFC Champions League Elite third round, outlining the threat ahead and the selection puzzles he is juggling. According to Goal.com, the Italian addressed key opponents and his squad's condition in a pre-match briefing.
 He singled out Riyad Mahrez for praise and noted the quality in the Qatari side, namechecking Spain's Pablo Mari among others. Inzaghi said his team are prepared to meet that standard and do what is required.
 OneFootball Videos
 The coach stressed concentration will be crucial, describing Al-Shamal as well organised with a capable coach and players. He said recent performances underline they are no pushovers.
 Inzaghi framed recovery as the parallel contest, with a congested calendar demanding careful work from his coaching and medical staff to keep players fresh without risking priority fixtures.
 He raised doubts over Martinelli after the Al-Qadsiah game and said Mohamed Mazhari required rest. Ruben Neves will miss the Al-Shamal tie, while Sergej Milinkovic-Savic's involvement depends on training.
 He added that the upcoming meeting with Al-Fateh will influence rotation, as Al-Hilal seek to keep momentum without overloading the squad.
 Source: Goal.com
